mapper.select: select approve_status, count(id) from first_mile_delivery where is_deleted = false group by approve_status

SELECT approve_status AS tabFlag, count(*) AS count FROM first_mile_delivery WHERE is_deleted=FALSE
GROUP BY approve_status

SELECT fd.code AS deliveryCode, CASE WHEN approve_status = 'approve' THEN '已发货' ELSE '未发货' END AS deliveryStatus, CASE WHEN approve_status = 'approve' THEN '已发货' ELSE '未发货' END AS deliveryStatusName, SUM(fdd.delivery_qty) AS deliveryQty, fd.approve_time AS deliveryTime FROM first_mile_delivery fd INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery_detail fdd ON fd.id = fdd.main_id AND fdd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fd.is_deleted = FALSE
AND fd.source_id IN
#{sourceId}
GROUP BY fd.code, deliveryStatus, fd.approve_time ORDER BY fd.code DESC

SELECT fd.code, fdd.id, fdd.main_id, fdd.sku_id, fdd.sku_no, fd.delivery_warehouse_id AS warehouseId, fd.delivery_warehouse_name AS warehouseName, fdd.warehouse_location, fdd.delivery_qty AS assembleQty FROM first_mile_delivery fd INNER JOIN first_mile_delivery_detail fdd ON fd.id = fdd.main_id AND fdd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fd.is_deleted = FALSE AND fdd.is_combination = TRUE
AND fd.id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY fd.code DESC

SELECT fmd.id, fmcb.box_no, concat(box_length, '*', fmc.box_width, '*', fmc.box_height) AS boxSize, box_length*box_width*box_height as multiplySize, fmc.package_weight, fmcb.box_desc, fmc.box_length as length, fmc.box_width as width, fmc.box_height as height, (select string_agg(cd.sku_no , ',') from wms_carton_detail cd where cd.is_deleted = false and cd.carton_id = fmc.id) as sku FROM first_mile_delivery fmd INNER JOIN wms_carton fmc ON fmc.source_id = fmd.id AND fmc.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN wms_carton_bill fmcb ON fmc.id = fmcb.carton_id AND fmcb.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE fmd.is_deleted = FALSE
AND fmd.id IN
#{id}
ORDER BY CAST(fmcb.box_no AS INTEGER)

select fmd.* from first_mile_delivery fmd left join warehouse fw on fmd.delivery_warehouse_id = fw.id and fw.is_deleted =false left join warehouse tw on fmd.dest_warehouse_id = tw.id and tw.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and fmd.is_deleted = false
